title: Chapter 86 Crazy Shopping
content:
Chapter 86 Crazy Shopping

Wang Shuo took the thunderbolt.

[Thunderbolt: Causes 500 health points of damage to enemies within 2 square meters, and 200 points of burning damage to enemies within 5 square meters. ]

Wang Shuo narrowed his eyes and asked, "How many of these do you have?"

If the number is too small, it won't make much sense.

"1500."

When Wang Shuo heard this, his heart became hot, but his expression remained unchanged, and he nodded and said, "What's the price?"

"50 gold coins each."

Wang Shuo's breathing became rapid.

Throwing one out means 50 gold coins.

In order to prevent the other party from looking down on him, he said calmly, "Are there any other things?"

"Of course, this is a city wall defense charm."

[City wall defense charm: Each city wall defense charm can temporarily increase the height of the city wall by 10 meters, with a durability of 10,000 points. ]

Wang Shuo thought about it, his outer wall was only more than 2 meters high, and a beast with a slightly better jumping ability could jump in with a light jump.

He was worrying about how to build effective fortifications!

The wall defense talisman just solved this problem.

"How much is this one?"

"100 gold coins per piece. I don't need to say much about the value of this thing. It is definitely a good thing." Hadro looked confident.

These things, but he spent a lot of money to collect them.

"This is a bronze crossbow construction drawing, worth 5,000 gold coins. A weapon for defending the city, the single attack can reach up to 2,000 damage, and it can also fire 5 spears at the same time, each with an attack power of 500 points."

"It's really a good thing." Wang Shuo was shocked.

In the system store of Nanshanji, Wang Shuo could only buy some bulk living supplies. The combat supplies that could be used to guard the village this time were only big red medicine and tung oil, and the attack power was completely insufficient.

This thunder and bronze crossbow can greatly enhance the attack power, so it must be bought.

Wang Shuo counted his gold coins. He had already spent 16,000 in Nanshan Market, and now he had 28,000.

And the thunderbolt alone would cost 75,000.

In addition, the bronze crossbow cart would cost 5,000 gold coins, and the wall defense talisman would cost about 200 pieces, and here is another 20,000.

A total of 100,000 is needed.

Wang Shuo looked at his backpack. He still had 45,000 energy crystals, which scared him.

He then remembered that those fearless bees alone contributed more than 20,000 to him.

At this moment, he finally had a little confidence.

"I want all these things."

"Lord, you are generous!"

Hadro's face was full of joy.

"I also have a skill book "Petrification" here."

Seeing Wang Shuo so generous, Hadro took out the skill book, and at the same time, he held an unknown talisman paper in his left hand.

[Petrification: The whole body is covered with hard petrified skin, defense +100, the body size becomes 1 times larger, the strength increases by 2 times, and the physique increases by 10 times. ]

"Oh my god, this skill..."

Wang Shuo swallowed a mouthful of saliva, and could no longer hold back his reserve, and his face showed undisguised eagerness.

Hadro had already expected Wang Shuo's reaction.

Anyone who saw this skill book without any occupation requirements could not help but be moved.

"How much do you plan to sell it for?" After a long while, Wang Shuo calmed down and asked lightly.

Seeing the talisman paper in Hadro's other hand, Wang Shuo did not want to rob it.

A businessman, if he did not have the means to ensure his safe transactions, would have been eaten up long ago.

"100,000 gold coins." Hadro was relieved to see that Wang Shuo did not move, and at the same time he looked up to Wang Shuo a little.
